title: Real estate agency office room key

infobox.usage: Unlocks an office on the second floor of the real estate agency on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Real estate agency office room key (REA) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the office inside the city real estate agency.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a possible location for the quest Properties All Around

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Streets of Tarkov
sections.text: On the first floor of the real estate agency, in a key rack behind the reception desk.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Office on the second floor of the real estate agency at Streets of Tarkov.
